quote: The prima facie speed limit shall be fifteen miles per hour when traversing any intersection or street or highway if during the last one hundred feet of his approach to such intersection the driver does not have a clear and unobstructed view of such intersection and of any traffic upon all of the streets or highways entering such intersection for a distance of one hundred feet along all such streets or highways, except on a through street or highway or at a traffic-controlled intersection.

activation.condition: During the last 100 feet of approach, the driver lacks a clear unobstructed view of the intersection and traffic on every entering street/highway for 100 feet.

obligation.description: The exact text gives a fifteen-mile-per-hour prima facie traversal value under the sight condition; no legal verdict follows from the probe.
